title: Compile reasoning methods into executable obligations

donor_sources.observation: One ChainOfThought receives all lenses; automatic selection uses substring rules.

mechanism: Typed method DAG with applicability predicates, required inputs, checked operations, and obligations.
challenge: Missing competing likelihood prevents Bayesian execution; a quoted keyword does not select a method.

title: Compete causal fault hypotheses before rewriting

donor_sources.observation: Abduction is an LM signature; scientific deduction and causal execution remain commented steps.

mechanism: Competing fault hypotheses predict probe outcomes and are eliminated by observed counterexamples.
challenge: A probe equally predicted by both hypotheses earns no discriminating credit.

title: Check deductive fragments for candidate preconditions

donor_sources.observation: A model emits validity and inference prose; there is no formal proof checker.

mechanism: Small proof kernel checks bounded predicates and inference rules tied to candidate preconditions.
challenge: Affirming the consequent, integer overflow, and unsupported generalization fail independently of persuasive text.

title: Perform fully specified Bayesian candidate revision

donor_sources.observation: The signature lacks an alternative likelihood; scientific workflow supplies fixed prior .5 and placeholder likelihood .8.

mechanism: Deterministic posterior calculation with competing likelihoods, dependence groups, and sensitivity intervals.
challenge: One-percent prior with .99 sensitivity and .05 false-positive rate yields about16.67%, not99%.

title: Identify causal benefit of runtime interventions

donor_sources.observation: causal_graph is a natural-language methodology instruction; no intervention evaluator exists.

mechanism: Typed causal graph and controlled change comparison separate intervention effects from confounding.
challenge: A warm cache improves both old and new code; sequential benchmark timing must not credit the patch.

title: Forecast candidate performance from comparable episodes

donor_sources.observation: Reference-class statistics are supplied by a model rather than retrieved empirical cohorts.

mechanism: Eligibility-defined comparable cohorts produce performance distributions and transport warnings.
challenge: Removing failed candidates or mixing hardware generations changes apparent benefit and must be exposed.

title: Choose code changes on robust constrained frontiers

donor_sources.observation: decision_theory requests prose expected-value comparisons without constraint-solving implementation.

mechanism: Hard feasibility gates precede Pareto and robust-regret comparisons across uncertain candidate outcomes.
challenge: A faster candidate with one correctness violation cannot buy admission with any speed score.

title: Select the next experiment by decision value

donor_sources.observation: cruxes and next_steps are generated text with no expected decision-value calculation.

mechanism: Enumerate experiment outcomes and calculate expected decision improvement minus resource cost.
challenge: A high-entropy unknown that cannot change the selected implementation has zero decision value.

title: Turn rewrite premortems into executable conditions

donor_sources.observation: Premortem outputs failure scenarios and mitigations as model-generated text.

mechanism: Candidate-specific failure models compile to bounded predicates and corresponding decision transitions.
challenge: Missing telemetry is unknown and counter reset cannot satisfy a safety trigger.

title: Transfer algorithms through structural analogy checks

donor_sources.observation: Analogy mapping, disanalogies and confidence are emitted by a model without an applicability checker.

mechanism: Typed relational mappings transfer algorithmic templates only when required semantic boundaries hold.
challenge: A cache strategy valid for idempotent reads must not transfer to exactly-once mutations.

title: Ground decision-bias audits in source spans

donor_sources.observation: The signature requests evidence spans but permissive assembly accepts incomplete or malformed bias records.

mechanism: Audit decision dependencies using exact spans and executable relevance checks without forcing bias labels.
challenge: Mentioning past investment as historical context alone must not count as sunk-cost reasoning.

title: Test code decisions for framing invariance

donor_sources.observation: Counterpositions and deliberate reconsideration are generated prose without controlled invariance tests.

mechanism: Meaning-preserving decision transformations reveal unjustified recommendation shifts across wording and anchors.
challenge: Equivalent ninety-percent success versus ten-percent failure records should not reverse identical code choices.

title: Propagate critique into code decisions

donor_sources.observation: Corrected analyses are produced but final_synthesis still returns the original multi.synthesis.

mechanism: Material critiques invalidate dependent decisions until accepted, rebutted, or explicitly unresolved.
challenge: A disproven bounds premise cannot survive into the final choice through an unchanged original synthesis.

title: Investigate rewrite candidates with independent dissent

donor_sources.observation: One pipeline generates counterarguments then asks a model to synthesize a balanced view.

mechanism: Blind independent investigations adjudicate disagreement with reproducible witnesses rather than majority votes.
challenge: Three agreeing investigators citing one erroneous measurement cannot outvote a concrete failing input.

title: Calibrate rewrite confidence against actual outcomes

donor_sources.observation: Evaluation uses model score strings; absent post-analysis can yield verification_success=True.
A failed verification bias detector sets biases_after to zero while the reduction operation still reports success.

mechanism: Proper scoring and calibrated decision bins distinguish predicted success, observed success, failure, and unknown.
challenge: Verification timeout must remain unknown and never improve a candidate success statistic.

title: Bound rewrite resources with dimensional estimates

donor_sources.observation: fermi_estimation is a textual instruction, with no units or interval arithmetic implementation.

mechanism: Dimensioned interval expressions estimate candidate resource demand and expose dominant uncertainties.
challenge: Requests per second times bytes per request is bandwidth, not total memory without a retention duration.

title: Escalate reasoning only when observed risk warrants it

donor_sources.observation: Dual process always runs two model stages; weak recognition can still become the final heuristic decision.

mechanism: Risk features and unresolved obligations trigger deeper reasoning while exact easy cases stay deterministic.
challenge: Confident cheap-model output cannot suppress escalation for a patch changing ownership or bounds.

title: Allocate reasoning portfolios by complementary error

donor_sources.observation: Independent stages run in two fixed waves; activation is based on simple query substrings.

mechanism: Select bounded method/model sets by measured marginal error coverage and resource cost.
challenge: Two highly accurate agents making the same errors can add less value than a weaker complementary verifier.

title: Distill runtime lessons into typed executable procedures

donor_sources.observation: Reusable methods are textual procedure descriptions and generated findings, not checked executable recipes.

mechanism: Successful episodes yield parameterized procedures with preconditions, governed operations, and transfer tests.
challenge: A lesson that hardcodes one example path or repeats a failed action cannot pass transfer acceptance.

title: Optimize prompts programs and topology under one oracle

donor_sources.observation: MIPROv2/GEPA wrappers exist; default metric rewards nonempty output or expected-answer substring.

mechanism: Bounded joint search mutates prompt instructions, typed procedure choices, and reasoning topology against independent validation.
challenge: Expected-answer text embedded in a wrong output and altered grader code must never earn promotion.
